trans-unit.source: Auto Sync Files: Download Only
Download a file from another Webpage periodically to your own Webspace, e.g. the Google-Analytics-Script
Auto Sync Files: Download & Extract
Download an archive (ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ), then optionally extract or replace existing files or folders.
Download URL
Download URL (e.g. https://example.com/file.txt)
e.g., https://example.com/file.txt
e.g., https://example.com/archive.zip
Local Path (absolute path inside TYPO3 public root)
Replace Mode
Replace target folder completely (contents will be deleted first)
If enabled: All files and subfolders inside the target folder are deleted before the new files are copied in. This only happens after the archive has been extracted successfully.
If disabled (default): Merge mode – archive files overwrite same-named entries, additional files in the target folder are kept.
The target folder itself is never deleted. Replace mode is not possible for the TYPO3 public directory itself or typo3temp/.
Clear Cache
Clear Cache after execution if files differ
Download URL is required.
Download URL must start with http:// or https://.
Local Path is required.
Replace mode is not allowed for the TYPO3 public directory itself or typo3temp/. Use Merge mode or a subfolder.
